candidates.title: Move Sign-In After Pet Adoption
candidates.change: Delay sign-in until after the user picks and names their pet so commitment happens after value discovery.
candidates.why: Sign-in has a high drop-off (72.9%) and long mean time (567s). Allowing users to pick their pet first reduces early friction.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in after pet adoption is explicitly allowed within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Moving sign-in downstream reduces early friction at a high drop-off step.

candidates.title: Desktop Controls Preview on Adoption Certificate
candidates.change: Redesign adoption certificate screen into a split layout previewing desktop interaction controls alongside the pet certificate.
candidates.why: Support mailbox received multiple tickets about users being confused on how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after setup.

adoption_certificate.headline: Meet Your Desktop Companion
adoption_certificate.body: Your adoption is official! Here is how you will control and interact with your pet on screen.

components.text: Right-click pet anytime to open controls or toggle desktop visibility.

guard.reason: Redesign removes the required official stamp component from the adoption certificate screen.

candidates.title: Add Desktop Permission Check Screen
candidates.change: Add a new screen before waiting that tests desktop overlay permissions and screen rendering.
candidates.why: Support mail shows complaints where pets do not appear on desktop or features misbehave after setup.

guard.reason: _order names screens that are neither onboarding screens nor defined here: ['new_desktop_check']

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Control Guide on Finish
candidates.change: Turn the home welcome screen into a step-by-step interactive stage showing how to move, hide, and interact with the pet.
candidates.why: Users are confused after onboarding about how to control or hide their pet, leading to support requests.

home_intro.headline: Quick Desktop Pet Tutorial
home_intro.body: Learn the essential shortcuts and gestures to summon, move, and talk with your pet.

guard.reason: Redesigning the home intro into an interactive desktop guide is permitted within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high finish drop-off and frequent support queries about controls.

candidates.title: Rebuild Welcome Story with Mascot
candidates.change: Redesign the opening story screen into an engaging card view with animated pet mascot preview.
candidates.why: The onboarding finish rate is low (17.8%), so building immediate emotional connection on screen 1 increases completion.

story.headline: Welcome to Desktop Pets!
story.body: Adopt an interactive animated friend that stays on your desktop while you study or work.

guard.reason: Story screen redesign maintains the pet introduction job.

candidates.score_note: Full redesign of step 1 to build early emotional connection.

candidates.title: Account Persistence Warning on Sign In
candidates.change: Add explicit visual hint reassuring users that signing in saves pet data across re-installs and device reboots.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or being reset after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Signing in ensures your pet memory, customization, and settings remain safe across re-installs.

guard.reason: Adding an explanatory sign-in hint is allowed and complies with all rules.

candidates.score_note: Low cost hint addressing 8 specific support emails about data loss.

candidates.title: Instant Ready-to-Adopt Pet Choice Grid
candidates.change: Re-layout friend selection into a grid with prominent instant pre-made pets alongside custom creation.
candidates.why: Adoption step takes 89s median / 1017s mean, and custom generation fails for some users. Preset options speed up the flow.

pick_friend.headline: Pick Your Companion
pick_friend.body: Choose a ready-to-play pet for instant setup, or create a custom pet.

guard.reason: Redesigning the pick friend step into a grid layout maintains its core function.

candidates.score_note: Targets the highest funnel drop-off step (39.1% loss) with instant presets.

candidates.title: Time Estimate & Error Safeguard on Waiting Screen
candidates.change: Display explicit rendering timer and helpful tips if pet generation takes longer than expected.
candidates.why: Home waiting screen has a mean time of 2336s and adoption bug reports state custom pets fail or stall.

waiting.hint: Generating your pet... If this takes over 60 seconds, check system display settings.

guard.reason: Adding a real time estimate and display safeguards on the waiting screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Helps recover users stuck during long pet generation (2336s mean time).

candidates.title: Background Rendering Desktop Notification
candidates.change: Enable desktop notification alert when pet setup finishes while user is waiting.
candidates.why: Waiting step takes median 201s / mean 2336s, suggesting users minimize the app and forget about it.

waiting.body: Your pet is getting ready! We will notify you on screen as soon as your companion is ready.

guard.reason: Adding desktop notification settings to the waiting screen is allowed within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Re-engages users who minimize the window during lengthy background setups.

candidates.title: Clear Path Selection Copy
candidates.change: Simplify onboarding path descriptions to clearly contrast fast setup versus custom creation.
candidates.why: Choose path screen has a mean time of 514s, indicating hesitation and confusion over options.

choose_path.headline: How Would You Like to Start?
choose_path.body: Select Quick Start to adopt instantly, or Custom Pet to design your friend from photos.

guard.reason: Updating choose path copy maintains options for both adopting instantly and creating a custom pet.

candidates.score_note: Simple copy fix addressing heavy decision hesitation (514s mean time).

decisions.title: Interactive Desktop Control Guide on Finish
Time Estimate & Error Safeguard on Waiting Screen

lessons_next: Reordering onboarding steps (moving sign-in after pet adoption) significantly improved performance and exceeded predictions (+16.8% measured vs +12.0% predicted).
New flow guides on finish screens showed no clear effect, and the predicted impact (+10.0%) was too high.
Adoption grid layout changes showed no clear effect, with predictions (+15.0%) being overly optimistic.
Waiting screen time estimates and error safeguards showed no clear effect, over-predicting impact (+8.0%).
Copy adjustments for path selection showed no clear effect, and predictions (+8.0%) were too high.
